subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw adopt agent schema version 11 and permanently replace the documented ACP `streamLogPath` contract with a new SQLite-backed retrieval API?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit acceptance for SQLite schema-version advancement, and the permanent replacement for an existing documented caller contract cannot be safely selected from implementation details alone.

options.title: Approve a compatible SQLite API
options.body: Approve schema version 11 only after the PR exposes a stable ACP history handle or retrieval API, migrates all consumers, and proves fresh and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Approve the breaking removal
options.body: Explicitly accept removal of `streamLogPath`, document the upgrade impact and supported replacement workflow, and require live proof that operators can still retrieve diagnostics.

options.title: Split the migration
options.body: Pause this combined branch and land audit, memory, and ACP storage changes as separately reviewed migrations with independent upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Approve a compatible SQLite API
recommendation.body: Approve schema version 11 only after the PR exposes a stable ACP history handle or retrieval API, migrates all consumers, and proves fresh and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite flip provides the closest current-main ownership evidence for per-agent schema and migration direction.
